value.title: The /pij community route and optional templates
The /pij community route, its registry row and PEC in bootstrap.md
value.success: skills/pij/references/routes/community.md teaches the prime, the PM and the PA in the PEC wording (C26, C18), linking the doc procedures; SKILL.md registers it; pij-skill-check knows it and states its line budget; bootstrap.md names PEC.

value.title: Optional role templates, written fresh and embedded
value.success: v1 templates for the optional roles under templates/roles/<name>/v1/, each validating, public-safe and marked as an example in the README; compiled into the daemon through SHIPPED.

value.title: pij directory templates --show <name>[@vN] (F23)

value.title: C28 in the community route: recommend roles from need
